result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor’s then-current rates, requires machine-readable data return within 30 days of Customer’s request, and requires certified deletion after successful return. The amendment appropriately resolves the contradiction in Section 11.1 while preserving the existing, more detailed data-return and deletion protections in Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
